statements.query:
INSERT INTO mesh_jobs.admissions AS a (namespace) VALUES ($1)
             ON CONFLICT (namespace) DO UPDATE SET fence = NOT a.fence
INSERT INTO public.mesh_jobs_parity_product (engine, namespace, request_id) VALUES ($3, $1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object($1, a.usename,
                    $2, a.pid, $3, coalesce(s.ssl, $4))), $5)
          FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_stat_ssl s USING (pid)
          WHERE a.datname = current_database()
            AND a.usename IN ($6, $7, $8))::text AS value

SELECT (SELECT json_build_object(
                      $1, current_user,
                      $2, (SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid = pg_backend_pid()),
                      $3, current_setting($4)::integer,
                      $5, (SELECT datconnlimit FROM pg_database
                                                      WHERE datname = current_database()),
                      $6, current_setting($7)::integer,
                      $8, current_setting($9)::integer,
                      $10, current_setting($11) = $12
                                 AND current_setting($13) = $14
                                 AND current_setting($15) = $16,
                      $17, current_setting($18) = $19))::text AS value

SELECT (SELECT json_build_object(
 $1, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity
                    WHERE usename IN ($2, $3, $4)
                    AND datname = current_database()),
 $5, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = $6),
 $7, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ($8,$9,$10))
)
FROM mesh_jobs.jobs WHERE namespace = $11)::text AS value

SELECT (SELECT json_build_object(
 $1, coalesce(sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE rolname=$2),$3),
 $4, coalesce(sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE rolname=$5),$6),
 $7, coalesce(sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE rolname=$8),$9),
 $10, coalesce(sum(calls) FILTER (WHERE rolname=$11 AND (query LIKE $12)),$13),
 $14, (SELECT dealloc FROM pg_stat_statements_info)
)
FROM pg_stat_statements JOIN pg_roles ON userid = pg_roles.oid
WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = $15)
  AND rolname IN ($16, $17, $18))::text AS value

SELECT (SELECT json_build_object($1, pg_backend_pid(),
                         $2, current_setting($3)))::text AS value
